package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	x := 10
	y := 3

	fmt.Println("=== Operator Aritmatika ===")
	fmt.Printf("%d + %d = %d\n", x, y, x+y)
	fmt.Printf("%d / %d = %d (Integer division)\n", x, y, x/y)
	fmt.Printf("%d %% %d = %d (Modulus)\n", x, y, x%y)

	fmt.Println("\n=== Increment / Decrement ===")
	// x++ adalah statement, tidak bisa dimasukkan ke variabel lain
	x++
	fmt.Printf("Setelah x++, nilai x = %d\n", x)

	fmt.Println("\n=== Operator Logika & Perbandingan ===")
	isActive := true
	hasAccess := false
	fmt.Printf("x > y && isActive = %v\n", x > y && isActive)
	fmt.Printf("isActive || hasAccess = %v\n", isActive || hasAccess)
}
